item.title: Build Your AI Follow-up Assistant
item.description: Turn messy notes from a meeting, customer enquiry, or supplier call into a clear recap, next steps, and a message you can review and send. Build and save your own AI follow-up assistant in one hands-on, offline session. No coding. Sunday, 27 September 2026, 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Salt Lake, Kolkata. 50 seats. ₹799.
